mapper.sql: select e.*, u.user_name, d.dept_name, s.shift_name as default_shift_name from hr_employee e left join sys_user u on u.user_id = e.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = e.dept_id left join hr_shift s on s.shift_id = e.default_shift_id
mapper.insert: insert into hr_employee(user_id, dept_id, employee_no, job_type, attend_enabled, default_shift_group, default_shift_id, device_user_no, join_date, work_status, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time) values(#{userId}, #{deptId}, #{employeeNo}, #{jobType}, #{attendEnabled}, #{defaultShiftGroup}, #{defaultShiftId}, #{deviceUserNo}, #{joinDate}, #{workStatus}, '0', #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update hr_employee set del_flag = '2' where hr_employee_id in #{id}
update hr_employee set default_shift_id = #{arg0}, update_by = #{arg1}, update_time = sysdate() where del_flag = '0' and hr_employee_id in #{id}
